name: Limitless X Holdings Inc.
summary: Limitless X Holdings Inc. is a dynamic lifestyle-focused enterprise specializing in a broad range of services, including brand development, product innovation, digital advertising strategies, and direct-to-consumer fulfillment. The company structures its operations across three distinct verticals, each housing a comprehensive ecosystem of integrated products and service-oriented businesses. These divisions primarily target the vibrant health and wellness, beauty and skincare, and CBD industries. Limitless X Holdings Inc. maintains its corporate headquarters in Beverly Hills, California.
